verdict.rationale: Asana ships a broad, well-documented REST API (tasks, projects, rules, webhooks, app components, OpenAPI spec, official SDKs, sandbox, deprecation/versioning process) plus an official MCP server exposing read/write/interactive tools, and even an endpoint for AI Teammate records, showing wide UI/API parity ambition. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of full 1:1 parity — newer UI-centric features like AI Studio no-code automations and Asana Dash 'AI Chief of Staff' are described only as UI/product features with no matching API/webhook endpoints shown, and no independent audit confirms complete parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or documentation, API/MCP coverage of AI Studio and Dash features, and independent verification of full UI-API equivalence.
